segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the 18 additional seats for the operations team and confirm the March 18 go-live is still the target.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We have 42 people today, adding 18 gets us to 60. The only wrinkle is finance wants the invoice to land after April 1 if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can set the order effective April 1 and still have the onboarding sessions in March. Billing would be $4,800 per month for the 60 seats, annual term through March 31 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the reporting module we talked about, not a separate line item?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Reporting is included at that tier. The only separate item is the one-time onboarding package at $2,250, and that covers two admin trainings plus the import review.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Legal asked whether the renewal stays annual or if it flips to monthly after the term.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It stays annual unless either side gives 30 days' notice before the renewal date. That's the same language in your current agreement, just with the updated seat count and dates.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. Can you send the order form today? I can route it to Marcus and Priya this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I'll send it over by 2:00 Pacific. It'll show 60 seats, April 1 start, March 31 end date, $4,800 monthly, and the $2,250 onboarding fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If Marcus has questions on the invoice timing, I'll loop you in, but otherwise we should be able to sign by Friday.
